- Do NOT push from heaven.
- Use a fresh isolated temp clone/worktree. Do not alter other checkouts.

- Read issue #60 / PR #59 context from the repository/GitHub refs available to you when useful.
- Keep secrets out of stdout, files, commits, and relay jobs.

TASK — FIX ONLY THE TWO INDEPENDENT-REVIEW BLOCKERS
1) Real heaven2-control -> heaven-heavy-worker execution:
   - Agent Control runs/control authority on heaven2.
   - Heavy/background worker execution target is heaven.
   - Do not pretend remote execution exists.
   - Add an explicit provider abstraction/contract for remote worker execution using the established Heaven Local Bridge / private GitHub relay contract.
   - Preserve machine-policy fail-closed behavior and explicit per-task repository-write authorization.
   - "auto" on heaven2 for heavy implementation/verification/review/repair work should resolve to heaven only when the authenticated/configured Heaven provider is actually available; otherwise fail closed with a clear blocker. Local-only control actions remain on heaven2.
   - No public listener. No secret copying to heaven.
   - Provider lifecycle/status must give Agent Control enough authoritative evidence to distinguish running/completed/failed/cancelled/stale. A stopped/crashed worker must never become successful/integration-eligible.
   - Prefer a bounded provider that emits/reads chatgpt-heaven-bridge-v2 queue/status/result envelopes and does not weaken existing security.
   - If an environment/config opt-in is needed, make it explicit and documented, with a deterministic local fake/test provider for tests.

2) Safe Codex launch contract:
   - Remove the direct local worker launch use of --approve-for-me.
   - Do not replace it with an invented unsafe flag.
   - The already-validated Heaven bridge invokes Codex as: codex exec --skip-git-repo-check - (Windows .cmd wrapper uses cmd.exe /d /s /c call <codex.cmd> exec --skip-git-repo-check -).
   - Route remote heaven execution through the provider/bridge contract instead of spawning local Codex on heaven2.
   - If local Codex fallback remains supported, use a safe explicit invocation contract and test the exact argv; do not silently grant approvals.

ADDITIONAL REVIEW EVIDENCE TO RESPECT
- Existing deployOne currently has assertWorkerPlacement() that rejects non-local targets and then locally spawn(codex,...).
- Existing args currently include ["exec","--json","--approve-for-me",...].
- Current Agent Control exact reconciled candidate previously passed npm.cmd run check and npm.cmd test 45/45.
- Existing restart/orphan/lease/stop semantics are positive and must not regress.
- Branch sync from workers must avoid shared FETCH_HEAD mutation races; isolated clone/worktree is OK for this task. Do not broadly redesign unrelated Git workflows.

IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS
- Keep scope concentrated in tools/agent-control and its tests/docs, plus only minimal config/provider surface required.
- Add deterministic regressions proving:
  a) heaven2 + available Heaven provider places heavy worker on heaven, not heaven2;
  b) unavailable/unhealthy provider fails closed and does not fake success;
  c) local/control-only work stays local where intended;
  d) exact worker launch/provider request contains no --approve-for-me;
  e) remote result failed/cancelled/stale cannot become successful/integration-eligible;
  f) existing machine repository-write policy remains enforced.
- Do not weaken current autonomy permissions, routing-manifest freshness, lease/capacity, restart/orphan, integration eligibility, or loopback-only server security.
- Run from tools/agent-control with Windows reliable shim:
  npm.cmd run check
  npm.cmd test
- Run any focused live/fake provider tests you add.
- Keep working tree clean after commit.

OUTPUT / ARTIFACTS
- Commit locally with a clear message.
- Save a binary-capable patch containing only your commits relative to the original PR #59 remote head to:
  C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\artifacts\release-20260929-agentcontrol-provider-fix.patch
- Save JSON evidence to:
  C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\artifacts\release-20260929-agentcontrol-provider-fix.json
  with: repo_path, refreshed_main_sha, original_pr_head_sha, reconciled_parent_sha, final_head_sha, changed_files, tests [{command,result}], implementation_summary, remaining_blockers, worktree_clean.
- Print the same JSON exactly between:
BEGIN_RELEASE_RESULT
{...valid JSON...}
END_RELEASE_RESULT

If the current branch/main moved while you work, reconcile safely in your isolated worktree and report exact SHAs. Do not push.
